title: Irish Stew with Bramley Apples
description: A hearty and flavorful Irish stew made with tender lamb, crunchy Bramley apples, and a hint of sweetness.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the lamb in batches until browned on all sides, then set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the flour to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually add the beef broth, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Return the browned lamb to the pot and add the chopped Bramley apples.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 hours.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
